text:
elaine: FYI prepping cutover playbook for Acme POC. Customer requires SSO (Okta SAML), SCIM provisioning, fine-grained RBAC, and domain ownership proof. Tight on compliance. @sam can you lead the technical pre-sale side? :raising_hand:

sam: on it. quick q: Do they require domain-verified email claim (mx/txt) or just IdP assertion+allowlist?

mike-it: we need domain verified (TXT) for automatic tenant binding. can't use manual allow-list for 10k users.

nathan: SCIM notes: we'll use incremental delta sync. watch bulk import for initial seed — rate-limit is 100 req/min on hosted, dedicated can be configured. mapping example:
```
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "{{email}}",
  "name": {"givenName":"{{first}}","familyName":"{{last}}"},
  "groups": ["{{roles}}"]
}
```
Use group->RBAC mapping for least privilege. recommend test set of 50 users for POC.

rebecca: security checklist: KMS-backed key for audit logs, support for cert rotation and SAML metadata fingerprinting, SCIM write ACLs (scoped token), and full audit export to SIEM. also need SOC2 relevant docs for Dedicated/private.

sam: for SAML, we'll provide metadata + instructions. command to fetch current cert: `curl https://idp.company/.well-known/saml-metadata | xmllint --xpath '\'//ds:X509Certificate/text()\'' -`

elaine: pricing ask from customer: if they reserve dedicated capacity what's included re: SCIM throughput and SAML CPS? Do we charge per-provisioning call?

sam: short answer: Dedicated includes configurable SCIM throughput as part of committed units; hosted has admin API quotas. provisioning calls are part of control-plane requests and not billed per-call in most plans, but very large bulk imports may trigger rate-limited billing — will confirm with finance. :money_with_wings:

deploy-bot: Env created: rdw-dedicated-acme-001 (region: us-east-2) — assigned to sam

nathan: POC plan proposal:
- week 0: domain TXT proof + SAML metadata exchange
- week 1: SCIM initial seed (50 users) + role mapping test
- week 2: RBAC fine tuning + perf test (latency/cost) 
Need their Okta admin + a service account with SCIM write scope.

mike-it: we can provide Okta SSO admin and a separate SCIM service account. timeline looks good.

elaine: ok let's sync Wed 10am PT. I'll send calendar + checklist. Next steps: sam to draft runbook, rebecca to attach security artifacts, finance to confirm billing note.

sam: will draft runbook today and post link here. :thumbsup:
